observations.text: Consolidate duplicate run_pipeline.py files (root and scripts/) into a single entry point. Wire scripts/arxiv_scraper.py into run_pipeline.py so that its output updates docs/online_research_summary.md and candidate_materials.md automatically.

Implement real DFT computation logic in dft_calculator.py using an open-source engine (e.g., ASE + GPAW) to compute electronic structure and electron-phonon cou — all retries exhausted (last: worker returned no hunks); no failover model in chain

Populate data/superconductor_database.json with verified Tc, composition, and pressure data from SuperCon or literature mining, ensuring scripts/generate_candidates.py and scripts/predict_tc.py load f — run stopping

Add a dedicated subsection on 'chemical precompression' strategies (e.g., ternary hydrides Li2MgH16, CaYH12) under Manufacturing Pathways in proposed_chemistry_physics.md to detail approaches for lowe — run stopping

Implement missing functions (fetch_materials_project, fetch_icsd, fetch_arxiv) in scripts/api_client.py and add 'from unittest.mock import patch' to tests, or rewrite tests to use PipelineClient. Also create a minimal FastAPI server (app.py) implementing /candidates, /submit, /batch_predict endpoints, or modify client for offline mode.
